name: followthemoney-builder
description: Manually build structured Follow the Money data and upload to OpenAleph instances.

scripts.export: npm run build && mkdir -p FTMBuilder && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css FTMBuilder && zip -r FTMBuilder FTMBuilder && rm -r FTMBuilder
scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "${PLUGIN_DEPLOY_DIR:-.}/FTMBuilder" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "${PLUGIN_DEPLOY_DIR:-.}/FTMBuilder"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
